mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines relative to its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in residential construction permits indicates a tightening labor market and strong housing demand, accelerating economic growth and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between UNRATE decline and HOUST increase fails to produce positive 60-day returns in at least 60% of instances, or Rank IC for the interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions with high residential spending (RSAFS) and elevated housing starts (HOUST), the S&P 500 underperforms due to stretched valuations and impending policy tightening, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST are both above their 5-year moving averages, or Rank IC for the regime condition falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month moving average signals strengthening consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises relative to its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate and decline in industrial production signals monetary tightening suppressing economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS increase and INDPRO decline fails to produce negative 60-day returns in at least 60% of instances, or Rank IC for the interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the S&P 500 underperforms as the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive policy, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
